{{Top}}
A '''targeting laser''' was a small device affixed to or built into the body of a weapon. It allowed the wielder of the weapon greater accuracy, as a harmless laser beam, invisible to the naked [[Eye/Legends|eye]], was emitted from the spot-luma onto whatever surface at which the barrel of the weapon was directed, creating a small spot of light which indicated where the weapon's armaments were to hit.

In some cases, however, the added accuracy conferred by a spot-luma brought with it other disadvantages. Just as the device indicated to the weapon's wielder the pinpoint location of his aim, it also gave away his or her approximate location and distance, depending on the size and position of the dot of light.

==History==
Targeting lasers were in existence since at least the [[Jedi Civil War]], where they were often attached to [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] for improved accuracy.<ref name="kotor1">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="kotor2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

[[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhoppers]] featured targeting lasers.<ref name="RS I guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms']] [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher]] featured an integrated targeting laser.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

The disadvantage of the targeting laser was exploited by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], while he was being pursued by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gaege Xarran]] on [[Vryssa]]. When approaching the room into which Fett had retreated, General Xarran failed to realize that his [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine's]] spot-luma was giving away his position, allowing the bounty hunter to preempt Xarran's next movements and kill him with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]].<ref name="ndp">{{JournalCite|14|No Disintegrations, Please}}</ref>

Another bounty hunter named [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] had a targeting laser built into his [[Ubese raider armor|helmet]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi junior novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novel]]</ref>
